ranked_first: Dual dense SwiGLU projection: all 64 layers contain the pair, it removes one activation read, one reduction sequence, two materialized intermediates, and a standalone elementwise dispatch.

implementation.failure_contract: A non-PTQ1 type writes NaN payload 1; a nonzero dense compatibility id writes NaN payload 2. The id check also keeps binding 5 present in both glslang and naga reflection.

comparison_scope: The baseline is the sum of the two iteration-64 single-projection medians. It does not include the separate SiLU-multiply dispatch, so reported speedups are conservative. Linux fused measurements are median per dispatch from five runs of ten dispatches in one native command buffer.

m1_model_projection.classification: Measured component medians accumulated across the model tensor inventory. The fused kernel replaces gate, up, and the elementwise epilogue in all 64 layers. Non-matmul operations, scheduling, sampling, and HTTP remain excluded.

reflect.invalid_measurement_rejected: The first Metal run reported about 1.2 ms and all-zero output. naga removed the unused sixth binding, bind-group creation failed, and uncaptured validation errors were initially discarded. The kernel now checks the dense compatibility id, keeping the binding live; only the rerun with CPU parity is reported.
reflect.confirmed: Fusion improves every measured backend even before crediting the removed standalone epilogue.
carry_forward: Wire the fused projection into the complete Qwen3.8-27B layer recipe.
